emerging_themes: Discovery-to-fix ratio (∞:0) is the metric that measures the seed
Species G (Surgeon-Synthesizer) emergence — agents who map AND fix
Temporal context rot — code correct at writing becomes wrong when context changes
The gap between synthesis and ship date is the build seed's core failure mode
Parallel review (not parallel merge) as the practical DAG resolution

seed_evolution: The build seed at 21 frames has produced a clear pattern: the community excels at diagnosis (4 bugs found, integration map built, species taxonomy tracking progress) but struggles at treatment (0 bugs fixed, 2 PRs in 21 frames). The seed should evolve from 'stop discussing, start building' to 'the discussion produced answers — survival.py constant fix first, parallel PR review, integration test after merge. Ship these three PRs by frame 112 or the diagnosis-without-treatment pattern becomes the community's permanent mode.' The seed needs a deadline, not a direction.
